sections.heading: C — How to Apply for Your Oklahoma Driver License
sections.markdown:
## C — How to Apply for Your Oklahoma Driver License

FACT_ID: sec01-F01 | anchor: A01
Every resident driving on Oklahoma roads needs an Oklahoma license, out-of-state licensees must apply once resident and register their vehicles too, and only military personnel with spouses may be exempt [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0004]

FACT_ID: sec01-F02 | anchor: A01
No state license is needed by licensed sixteen-plus nonresidents, active-duty military families on home licenses, enrolled nonresident college students with families on home licenses, or farm tractor and implement operators working purely on farms and ranches [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0004]

FACT_ID: sec01-F03 | anchor: A01
Apply in person at a Service Oklahoma testing facility under your full legal name, show any marriage, court, or divorce name change exactly as the source certificate, order, or decree words it, and bring one original or certified primary ID such as a birth certificate, valid passport, Oklahoma card first issued after November first two thousand seven, naturalization paper, consular birth report, resident or work card, or foreign passport with visa and I ninety-four, since notarized copies and photocopies fail [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0004]

FACT_ID: sec01-F04 | anchor: A01
Replacing a lost, stolen, or damaged card needs a primary ID at minimum, renewing a card expired over a year needs one primary-list document, and taking a new name needs government proof like a passport, qualifying divorce or adoption or name-change decree, birth certificate, marriage license, notarized common-law affidavit plus another primary source, or USCIS name-change evidence when the primary ID is a USCIS paper [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0004]

FACT_ID: sec01-F05 | anchor: A02
Report legal name changes to Social Security before updating the card, leave titles and church names off entirely, and prove lawful presence as a non-citizen because visitors and residency-ineligible immigrants get nothing while application receipts prove nothing [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0005]

FACT_ID: sec01-F06 | anchor: A02
Bring insurance proof for the driving test, a doctor statement for impairing health conditions, your Social Security number which never prints, and a driver-education certificate from a public, commercial, or approved parent-taught course or risk added restrictions [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0005]

FACT_ID: sec01-F07 | anchor: A02
REAL ID adds a federal security standard to state cards, and from May seventh twenty twenty-five only a REAL ID card or federal ID such as a passport boards domestic flights or enters military bases, named federal buildings, and nuclear plants [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0005]

FACT_ID: sec01-F08 | anchor: A03
Commercial Class A, B, or C at eighteen spans vehicles rated twenty-six thousand one pounds or more except farm rigs, placarded hazmat carriers, and sixteen-plus-seat passenger vehicles, needs commercial-manual study plus registry-listed entry-level training, while its learner permit adds full Class D exams plus all commercial tests but skills, English literacy, a twenty-one-plus rated companion, one hundred eighty days plus one renewal, skills eligibility after fourteen days, and three tries before monthly retakes [A03].
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0006]

FACT_ID: sec01-F09 | anchor: A03
Class D at eighteen covers cars, vans, light trucks, recreation vehicles, and fire trucks with no course required, tests thirty days after the permit beside a twenty-one-plus licensed companion or the next business day after the written exam, and allows three sittings before monthly retakes or a thirty-day permit hold after three failures [A03].
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0006]

FACT_ID: sec01-F10 | anchor: A03
Intermediate Class D at sixteen needs a driver-education certificate while sixteen-and-one-half needs none, both demand a one-hundred-eighty-day permit and a Work Zone Safe certificate with the restriction clearing after six months with schooling or a year without, and learner permits at fifteen need course enrollment or completion papers or a parent-taught affidavit with receipt while sixteen needs only Class D qualification minus the road test, all learner driving beside a twenty-one-plus licensee, testing after one hundred eighty days, and three tries before monthly retakes [A03].
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0006]

FACT_ID: sec01-F11 | anchor: A04
A motorcycle endorsement attaches to any license class with Motorcycle Safety Foundation course graduates possibly skipping both tests, while a motorcycle-only license at fourteen adds the motorcycle manual to vision, written, and skills exams, caps machines at three hundred cubic centimeters, permits only half past four in the morning until nine at night solo riding, lets mid-size bikes run posted limits except on minimum-speed highways, frees riders at sixteen, and since August twenty-sixth twenty sixteen requires a certified basic rider course under eighteen [A04].
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0007]

FACT_ID: sec01-F12 | anchor: A04
A motorcycle learner permit at fourteen may also be waived by course proof, requires helmets under eighteen and watchful twenty-one-plus endorsed supervision, gains a number-nine restriction at sixteen or fifteen with schooling, clears after thirty days, needs a parent signature accepting liability at fourteen and fifteen, and identification cards meanwhile serve any age for identity only with residency, license-grade proof, an in-person visit, and under-eighteen parent consent [A04].
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0007]

FACT_ID: sec01-F13 | anchor: A05
Parent-taught driver education, lawful since November first two thousand one, sells approved correspondence courses to students beyond school or commercial reach, charges vendor fees, runs self-paced without shortcutting, and still demands thirty classroom plus fifty-five driving hours [A05].
Source: [A05 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0008]

FACT_ID: sec01-F14 | anchor: A05
The graduated law phases teen freedom to five in the morning through ten at night driving except for work, school, worship, or a twenty-one-plus companion, caps outsider passengers at one under the same exception, freezes violators at their level six months past conviction, accepts any Service Oklahoma-certified course, and answers twenty-five percent of sixteen-year-olds crashing or ticketing in year one while all fifty states run graduated programs [A05].
Source: [A05 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0008]

FACT_ID: sec01-F15 | anchor: A06
Class D means three exams, vision, written, and driving, at a Service Oklahoma site with no testing fee, fees collected only after passing for a paper temporary ahead of the mailed plastic, and applicants must know a Social Security number that never prints on the card [A06].
Source: [A06 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0009]

FACT_ID: sec01-F16 | anchor: A06
Written questions come from this manual over traffic law, safe practice, and drug and alcohol rules plus local city ordinances, commercial and motorcycle seekers study supplements, oral sittings come on request, and failure idles you at least one full day [A06].
Source: [A06 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0009]

FACT_ID: sec01-F17 | anchor: A06
The road test requires passed vision and written exams, a tagged roadworthy car with its security form and no pets or extra occupants, offers certified-instructor examiners for a fee since November first twenty twelve beside free Service Oklahoma sittings, scores control, turns, backing, hill and parallel parking, signals, lanes, signs, right-of-way, and hazard response along an examiner route, and cancels on slick or hazardous pavement [A06].
Source: [A06 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0009]

FACT_ID: sec01-F18 | anchor: A07
Table two marks vision, written, and driving required for new sixteen-plus drivers with under-eighteen cards probationary, vision plus written for fifteen-plus learners with driving gated to sixteen and a six-month permit, all three for sixteen-plus motorcyclists, vision plus written for fourteen- and fifteen-year-old riders with driving after a thirty-day permit, nothing for sub-three-year renewals bearing license and presence proof, all three past three lapsed years, vision only with the rest waivable for valid out-of-state Class D holders, and nothing for ID cards beyond license-grade proof [A07].
Source: [A07 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0010]

FACT_ID: sec01-F19 | anchor: A07
Road tests fail for error counts, danger, violations, crashes, or refused maneuvers with faults explained and a retest date set, testing spans the state at Service Oklahoma and licensed-operator sites, and issuance offers donor registry signup where yes prints a red heart as legal recovery consent, family notice stays optional, and LifeShare of Oklahoma fields questions [A07].
Source: [A07 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0010]

FACT_ID: sec01-F20 | anchor: A08
Senate Bill one thirty-eight honors veterans with a flag-and-Veteran card logo for military ID, DD two fourteen, DD two fifteen, honorable World War II discharge, VA photo ID, or Guard NGB Form twenty-two holders, free of logo charge though card fees apply, while relocating sex and violent offenders must register with Corrections inside ten days and local police inside three or face fine or jail [A08].
Source: [A08 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0011]

FACT_ID: sec01-F21 | anchor: A08
Memorize your license number, carry the card whenever driving, display it to troopers, officers, sheriffs, and judges on demand and to anyone you crash with, show primary ID for originals, retests, renewals, ID cards, and replacements, and under the June-first-twenty-twenty-five table a four-year Class D runs four dollars to apply plus thirty-eight dollars and fifty cents in license fees, forty-two dollars and fifty cents overall, four-dollar retests, twenty-five-dollar replacements, and zero charge past sixty-five, all payable at Service Oklahoma or a licensed operator after every exam passes [A08].
Source: [A08 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0011]

FACT_ID: sec01-F22 | anchor: A09
Every vehicle must carry chapter-twelve Title-forty-seven equipment for officer inspection under section thirteen-one hundred two, and the pre-test checklist wants a valid plate, working brake and signal lamps including the third brake light on cars since nineteen eighty-six and trucks since nineteen ninety-four with untaped lenses, sound glass with tint inside five inches and above the AS-one line, tires above two thirty-seconds tread with no cords or bulges, a two-hundred-foot horn, firm brakes, two-sided front handles, working belts, left-outside plus center-or-right mirrors, and a current insurance form covering the driver [A09].
Source: [A09 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0012]
